text:
Jess Carter: Heads up — promotion is blocked. ci/integration-e2e-aws failed on cleanup, looks like a namespaced resource leak. deploybot marked the candidate as 'blocked'. :grimacing:
Sam Li: saw that, reproducing locally now. failure is in integration/namespace_cleanup_test, timeout waiting for PVCs to detach.
Maria Gomez: @Sam any logs?
Sam Li: paste: ```
=== FAIL: integration/namespace_cleanup_test (120.34s)
--- FAIL: namespace_cleanup_test
    cleanup_test.go:87: timed out waiting for resources: persistentvolumeclaims remaining: [data-redis-5]
```
Jess Carter: remote cache/registry shows artifact uploaded fine. this seems purely env/test flakiness, but promotion is blocked by policy until integration passes.
DevOps Bot: Promotion blocked for release r2026.03.22 (candidate: sha-abc123). Reason: ci/integration-e2e-aws failed (namespace_cleanup_test).
Release Manager: We can't hold the whole cut for a flaky cleanup test. Options: pin to last-good candidate, manual-promote, or debug and re-run. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Maria Gomez: I'd prefer re-run first. If it flakes again, we can pin.
Sam Li: re-run attempts: I kicked off `/rerun ci/integration-e2e-aws --build 2026-03-22-rc --priority=high`. Job queued.
ci-bot: Job queued: ci/integration-e2e-aws (build 2026-03-22-rc-rerun-1). ETA ~6m.
DevOps Oncall: If rerun fails, we should collect kube events around PVC deletion. Common cause: finalizers stuck on CSI sidecar during heavy GC.
Sam Li: good call. I'll add a debug step to the job to `kubectl get events -n $NS --sort-by='.lastTimestamp'` and capture PVC describe.
Jess Carter: If rerun fails twice, let's do manual promote to the last-green (sha-abc120) and note the pinned reason in release notes. Release Manager, ok?
Release Manager: Agreed. Manual promote if 2/2 reruns fail. Also add a note: "Pinned to sha-abc120 due to flaky integration namespace cleanup test; follow-up: investigate CSI finalizer timeout."
DevOps Bot: Reminder: manual promote requires `release:promote --candidate=sha-abc120 --ticket=<JIRA>` and a +1 from eng on-call.
Maria Gomez: I'll be on-call for the promote if we need it.
ci-bot: Rerun completed: ci/integration-e2e-aws (build 2026-03-22-rc-rerun-1) — FAILED.
Sam Li: rerun failed, same timeout. grabbing debug artifacts now.
Sam Li: debug snippet: ```
$ kubectl -n integration logs csi-driver-xyz
E0301 12:11:08 1 csi.go:432] failed to detach volume "pvc-0a1b" : rpc error: code=DeadlineExceeded desc="context deadline exceeded"
```
DevOps Oncall: That looks like a transient CSI issue. We should try a second rerun with a small pause before teardown to give the driver some time. I'll patch test harness to sleep 15s before `kubectl delete namespace`.
Sam Li: kicked second rerun with patch. `/rerun ci/integration-e2e-aws --build 2026-03-22-rc-rerun-2`
ci-bot: Job queued: ci/integration-e2e-aws (build 2026-03-22-rc-rerun-2).
ci-bot: Rerun completed: ci/integration-e2e-aws (build 2026-03-22-rc-rerun-2) — PASSED. :tada:
DevOps Bot: Promotion unblocked for r2026.03.22 (candidate: sha-abc123).
Jess Carter: Great. I'll proceed with promote and update release notes with the pinned note? Wait — we didn't pin now since the candidate passed. Just add an entry: "Integration flake observed; transient CSI finalizer delay; fixed test harness to add short teardown wait."
Release Manager: Perfect. I'll include that in release notes and link the debug artifacts and the CI run IDs.
Maria Gomez: Filing follow-up ticket to track CSI driver upgrades in staging so we reduce future flakes: RDO-1123.
Jess Carter: Thanks all. Closing the block. :white_check_mark:
DevOps Bot: Deployment started for r2026.03.22 (sha-abc123).
